items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Yeah, that's the old man Coleman, that owned the house. ... Coleman. Used to own, own the whole square.

ctx.x: You would see a house now and then like this. Now and then, now and then.

Now and then, now and then. They didn't start building around that about 1915. I see. Well, we'll start asking about the park, which was right there. Was it, could you tell me where was the park, where the park, Lincoln Park was? Lincoln Park was right there where I lived there by the welfare. And the welfare is then, the whole thing was founded by the Cosset Avenue, Oleander, and Fushet. So it was a one whole block. The whole square. The whole square. I see. The whole square. And do you remember when it was…
Did they have a ferris wheel somewhere?
